line_or_section: data job, step 'Network simulator study regenerates'
finding: The CI data job cannot pass: regenerating the network simulator study rewrites the three committed SVG figures with a new timestamp and new random element ids, and the job runs git diff --exit-code over netsim/results.

finding: Following the plan as written pools Cortex-M33 and Cortex-M4 cycles: the L552 capture commands omit --board, capture.py defaults the header board to NUCLEO-L4R5ZI, parse.py takes the board column from that header, and compare.py groups by (experiment, label, board, cache_pass, scheme, variant, operation).
evidence: capture.py line 99: ap.add_argument('--board', default='NUCLEO-L4R5ZI'); parse.py line 108 board=header.get('board'); compare.py line 125 key includes r['board']. The L552 command lines in ONE_AFTERNOON.md are identical to the L4R5 lines except the --out path. The dry run (run_dry_run.py line 41) sets board explicitly, so the default was never exercised. Refutation rule 4 of PREDICTIONS_V5_BOARD.md needs the boards apart.
suggested_fix: Add --board NUCLEO-L552ZE-Q (and --board NUCLEO-L4R5ZI) to the generated commands, or make --board required, or derive the board from a META platform line; add a test that parses an L552 log without --board and fails.
